title: Microsoft Edge: one policy now controls Copilot Chat in the toolbar
summary: The roadmap facts, toolbar policy, default behaviour and registry setting are supported by Microsoft documentation. The Intune route stops before the specific setting, and the statement that no new agent behaviour is added is not documented. The action rating should reflect a launched change that can expose the toolbar icon without administrator action.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The change adds no new agent behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Edge 149 Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled unifying policy new agent behavior autonomy; read the icon policy reference and the Edge 149 unifying-controls release note. Neither states that agent behaviour is unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove 'No change:' and 'It adds no new agent behaviour.' Retain 'The policy controls whether the icon shows in the toolbar and applies when users access Copilot in the sidepane.'

claims.where: front matter: action
claims.claim: The prepare action rating fits a launched, medium-risk change that can restore toolbar visibility without administrator action.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; status: "launched"; risk: "medium"; 'a tenant that has not set Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled may find Copilot Chat showing in the toolbar where it was hidden before.'
claims.fix: Set action to 'act-now': the standard assigns that rating to launched changes reaching users without administrator action when risk is medium and there is a control to set.

claims.where: front matter: impact; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Medium impact fits this change to default toolbar behaviour.
claims.quote: impact: "medium"; 'Users in Microsoft Entra ID Edge profiles notice if the Copilot icon appears or disappears'; 'a tenant that has not set Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled may find Copilot Chat showing in the toolbar where it was hidden before.'
claims.fix: Set impact to 'high' and begin its rationale 'High.': the standard explicitly assigns high impact to a change to default behaviour. Keep the existing explanation of which users notice.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to decide or configure appears in the controls table.
claims.quote: 'Decide separately whether Copilot address bar suggestions are wanted, using CopilotAddressBarSuggestionsEnabled.' The controls table contains only the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat toolbar icon control.
claims.fix: The Before rollout step for CopilotAddressBarSuggestionsEnabled has no controls-table row. Remove that checklist step; the explanatory address-bar discussion can remain.
